items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: work with this organ player by the name of...they call him Buster.

ctx.x: work with this organ player by the name of...they call him Buster. He comes down through here every year. He has a ...(?)... of Texas, and he comes through here with Rook(?), and they play gigs together all the time there in Minneapolis.
Just considering life on the road -- because I know the Blue Devils did more traveling than almost any other band. They were always on the road. They did endless one-nighters.
